options: The physical disk volume's total capacity
SQL Server Agent job history
Allocated vs. free space inside the current database's files
Query execution plans currently in the plan cache
questions.explain: It reports space usage inside the files of the current database, which is especially useful for understanding tempdb's real free space.

questions.q: Why is sys.dm_db_file_space_usage particularly useful when run against tempdb?
options: Tempdb is the only database where this DMV works at all
It reports the last time tempdb was rebuilt
Tempdb space is reused constantly, so this DMV shows whether it's actually full versus just busy within its allocated size
It shows tempdb's backup history
questions.explain: Tempdb space gets reused constantly within the file's already-allocated size, so this DMV distinguishes 'full' from 'busy'.

questions.q: What does sys.dm_os_volume_stats return, and what does it require as input?
options: The underlying Windows volume's actual capacity and free space, given a database_id and file_id
Login permissions, given a login name
SQL Server version information, given no input
The number of rows in a table, given a table name
questions.explain: It's a DMF that takes database_id and file_id and returns real volume-level free space — the same figure Explorer would show.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what turns a single free-space query into a real capacity-monitoring system?
options: Switching all databases to the SIMPLE recovery model
Running the query only once, right before a drive fills up
Increasing every file's autogrowth percentage
Logging results to a history table on a schedule, so usage can be trended over time
questions.explain: A single run is just a snapshot; logging it daily via an Agent job lets a DBA project days-until-full at the current rate.

questions.q: What question can a logged capacity trend answer that a single point-in-time snapshot cannot?
options: How many days until this drive is full at the current rate
The exact SQL Server version installed on the instance
Whether DBCC CHECKDB found any consistency errors
Which logins have sysadmin privileges
questions.explain: Only a series of measurements over time supports projecting a future exhaustion date; a snapshot only shows current state.
